Name: Train Whistle
Author: Taskmaster2
Description:
The Train Whistle Mod brings a touch of magical mischief to Stardew Valley by giving players the power to summon trains on command. 
Using the enchanted jade whistle, you can call forth a steel dragon to thunder down the tracks, complete with mystical visual effects
and playful wizardly oversight. The mod blends lore and humor — Rasmodius himself monitors your experiments, sending letters of guidance
(and stern warnings if you try to bend reality too far). With safeguards in place to keep gameplay safe, the Train Whistle MOD 
transforms the railroad into a stage for magical spectacle, player delight, and a few tongue‑in‑cheek surprises.

Pair with the Train Tag MOD to create graffiti and then check it out on the trains you summon!
